brand_direction:
# Wildroot — Brand Direction

Premium botanical haircare. Plant-derived, salon-grade formulas made honest and warm.

**Five adjectives:** botanical · restorative · honest · warm · elevated

- **Voice:** confident, plainspoken, never hypey. Substantiated claims only.
- **Palette:** forest + sage greens, cream base, bark + terracotta accents.
- **Type:** Fraunces (display serif) for headings, Inter for body.

products.title: Rosemary Restore Shampoo Bar
products.blurb: Solid shampoo bar with rosemary + mint. ~60 washes. Sulfate-free.

products.title: Marula Repair Hair Oil
products.blurb: Lightweight marula + argan oil for split ends and frizz. Non-greasy.

products.title: Scalp Renewal Serum
products.blurb: Nightly scalp serum with niacinamide + rosemary to support a balanced scalp.
